profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at boodleAI
profile.summary:
A passionate software engineer with professional experience in custom AIX kernel module and FDA regulated Windows application development, as well as automation, system architecture, technical leadership, and innovation.

Expert with Delphi, C, C#, Java, Shell script, SQL. Proficient with Android, Python, Powershell, Node.js. Familiar with Scala, Haskell.

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description: boodleAI delivers predictive analytics applications that help organizations acquire and retain donors, consumers, and investors. It leverages proven AI/machine learning to rapidly model the untapped data sitting in organizations, along with billions of third party data points, to help organizations achieve significant lifts in conversion, acquisition, and retention rates. Using predictive analytics and AI/machine learning, boodleAI's models determine if someone is a fit for a certain cause, consumer product/service, or investment and enables organizations to make the right ask to the right person at the right time.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Since 2005, I have served as a Software Engineer at IBM in Tucson, AZ on the Copy Services team for the Enterprise Storage Server DS8000 product line. Our team is responsible for providing world class data migration, backup, and disaster recovery solutions. Additionally, I have served as a Customer Advocate facilitating the resolution of customer needs for a tri-state utility provider and one of the largest insurance and financial services companies in the world.

In this role, my experience ranges from interacting with customers on problem resolution and performance improvement, to writing simple tools to automate repetitive tasks or more complicated scripts to process and parse data, to analyzing and optimizing internal algorithms for improved system performance.

positions.title: Pre-Professional Programmer
positions.description:
While attending the University of Arizona full time, I was part of a two person team that developed and maintained Korn shell scripts for an Enterprise Storage Server (ESS) microcode development environment made up of several IBM RS/6000 servers.

I led the design and development of a command line interface performance metric monitoring solution written in Java for the IBM ESS Model 800 Global Mirror function. I strictly adhered to the internal
design and documentation process to meet the high quality expectations of the ESS product line. I headed regular design, documentation and code review meetings that helped achieve early delivery with zero test or field defects.
